purpose: Teach: 読み書き/本誌/常務/出回っ/既婚/上述/免責/全長

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員の読み書きを大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father valued literacy among the founding staff — he truly did.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Slight weight on 「大事に」. Eyes distant but warm. The tone of someone honoring a predecessor's choices without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは本誌の記者と懇談された
lines.en: Yes. Father maintained a close relationship with the magazine's editor.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Brief pause before the second sentence, as if accessing a specific memory. Clear-eyed, steady. The respect of a son acknowledging his father's deliberate choices.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、初代の常務として会社を支えられたぞ
lines.en: Your father, as the first managing director, carried the company through those early years.
lines.style: Voice carries the weight of time. Slow, thoughtful pacing. Soft on the closing phrase, like settling into a chair. The tone of someone who watched it happen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは類似品が市場に出回っても動じなかった
lines.en: Yes. Even when imitations flooded the market, Father remained unshaken.
lines.style: Quiet conviction on 「動じなかった」. Steady, almost understated. No embellishment — just the plain fact of his father's composure stated with respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、既婚社員に家族手当を出されたぞ
lines.en: Your father extended family allowances to married employees — a generous choice.
lines.style: Softer again. Pause before the second clause. Voice carries recognition of something that was uncommon, maybe even controversial. The tone of someone who understands what that decision cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは上述の通り、新理念を提示された
lines.en: Yes. As I mentioned, Father introduced new principles that guided everything that followed.
lines.style: Clear, grounded statement. Light emphasis on 「新理念」. Measured, not rushed. The tone of a son summarizing his father's legacy without overselling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、免責事項を契約書に明示するご決断もされた
lines.en: Your father made the decision to state liability terms explicitly in contracts — a farsighted choice.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate pacing on this practical wisdom. Voice carries the weight of foresight. Quiet admiration, almost private. The tone of someone recognizing uncommon diligence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の全長まで細かく確認された
lines.en: Yes. Father scrutinised every detail — even the exact specifications of the product itself.
lines.style: Calm, grounded finality. Gentle emphasis on the thoroughness implicit in 「細かく確認」. Voice settles. The closing tone of someone resting in the completeness of what was inherited.
